answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops bulk fakes. A new agent deposits 40 units, released only as its fingerprint steadies over 20 epochs, as saffron stains. An ocean of cheap clones cannot fake months of consistent timing and task mix. A zephyr of random checks tests behavior against the fingerprint and freezes mismatches. Faking 1,000 identities costs 40,000 units, above the split rewards. An honest agent pays 40 once for an undiluted share.
